verdict.rationale: Apify's docs say developers can build their own Actors and "Publish your Actors on Apify Store and earn regular passive income." The Store is a public marketplace of tens of thousands of Actors that others can run. Missing for 10: detail on monetization models (pricing options, revenue share, payouts), a documented publishing workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of developers earning revenue.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my custom scraper to a public marketplace and earn revenue when others use it

citations.quote: Publish your Actors on Apify Store and earn regular passive income.
You can run both your own Actors and Actors from Apify Store.
